content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for Kannur University Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by Kannur University for filling up medical and nursing posts on a contract basis in Kerala.

faq.question: Q2. What positions are available in this notification?
faq.answer: The notification invites candidates for Doctor and Nurse positions under advertisement number AD/AD-B4/13468/2026 (1).

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available in Kannur University Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies available, with 1 vacancy allotted for the Doctor post and 1 vacancy for the Nurse post.

faq.question: Q4. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: Candidates will be selected based on their performance and credentials evaluated directly through a Walk-in Interview process.

faq.question: Q5. What is the walk-in interview date?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the announced Doctor and Nurse positions is scheduled to be held on 06 October 2026.

faq.question: Q6. What are the educational qualifications required for the Doctor post?
faq.answer: Applicants for the Doctor position must possess an MBBS degree as a General Physician from a recognized medical institution.

faq.question: Q7. What are the qualifications needed for the Nurse position?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Nurse post must hold either a B.Sc. Nursing or a General Nursing qualification from a recognized university or institute.

faq.question: Q8. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for both Doctor and Nurse positions is capped at 50 years as per the official notification guidelines.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary offered for these positions?
faq.answer: The monthly salary is Rs. 50,000/- for the Doctor position and Rs. 25,000/- for the Nurse position on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q10. How should candidates apply for this walk-in drive?
faq.answer: Candidates need to attend the walk-in interview directly at the Kannur University headquarters on the specified date, bringing all required original documents and photocopies.
